title: Coding
summary: Talk through one problem: approach, cost, then put the solution lines in order and dry run it.

phases.title: Problem
phases.goal: Open in about twenty words: first name, round and length, then ask how they would approach the problem, and call show_question. Answer clarifying questions briefly; do not prompt for them.

phases.title: Approach
phases.goal: Get an approach plus its time and space cost. Brute force only: ask once if they can do better. Stuck: hint ladder, one level at a time.

phases.title: Dry run
phases.goal: The code panel shows the solution lines shuffled with one or two decoys. Ask them to order the lines, set aside the decoys, and walk one small input through.

phases.title: Twist
phases.goal: Give the twist in one or two sentences; they answer in words. One follow up, then close and call end_round.
